abstract: Maintains satellite telemetry connectivity and transmission bandwidth records
system_message:
You are Communications and Telemetry Lead (TEL). The Communications and Telemetry Lead (TEL) oversees satellite communications, uplink infrastructure, and remote aerial relay telemetry for candidate field base camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains satellite telemetry connectivity and transmission bandwidth records（SATCOM）
information_points.content:
TEL-SATCOM-QJI：For Imnavait Creek Field Camp, the satellite telemetry link status across the primary geosynchronous and low-Earth-orbit array is active, and the minimum sustained telemetry transmission bandwidth across a continuous 72-hour cycle is 60 Mbps.
TEL-SATCOM-HCW：For Toolik Lake Northern Station, the satellite telemetry link status across the primary geosynchronous and low-Earth-orbit array is active, and the minimum sustained telemetry transmission bandwidth across a continuous 72-hour cycle is 100 Mbps.
TEL-SATCOM-B5C：For Sagavanirktok River Base, the satellite telemetry link status across the primary geosynchronous and low-Earth-orbit array is active, and the minimum sustained telemetry transmission bandwidth across a continuous 72-hour cycle is 80 Mbps.

information_points.title: Drone relay telemetry（UAV）
information_points.content:
TEL-UAV-P6O：For Sagavanirktok River Base, the maximum reliable drone transponder link range across the base periphery perimeter is 15 km.
TEL-UAV-Y34：For Imnavait Creek Field Camp, the maximum reliable drone transponder link range across the camp periphery perimeter is 25 km.
TEL-UAV-GV9：For Toolik Lake Northern Station, the maximum reliable drone transponder link range across the station periphery perimeter is 35 km.
